message: Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libidn2 && ls lib/*.c | head -20

message.content:
Excellent! Now I can see the fix in the system library (2.3.3). At address `0x3a6c`, it does:
```
cmp    $0x3f,%rax    # compare strlen with 63
ja     3aa0           # if > 63, jump to error
```

And at `0x3aa0`:
```
mov    $0xffffff33,%ebx   # return -205 (IDN2_TOO_BIG_DOMAIN = -205 = 0xFFFFFF33)
```

So the fix adds a length check after `idn2_to_ascii_4i2` returns. The vulnerable version (2.1.0) doesn't have this check.
